senses.gloss: (b. h., cmp. ירד)to take down; to detach, break off, esp. a) to take honey out of the bee-hive.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Oktzin 3:10">Ukts. III, 10</cite> <he>כוורת … והרוֹדֶה ממנה וכ׳</he> a bee-hive … is regarded as landed estate …, and he who breaks honey out of it on the Sabbath &c.; <cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 10:7">Shebi. X, 7</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Batra 66a">B. Bath. 66ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Batra 80b">80ᵇ</cite>.

B. Mets. 64ᵃ ההולך … לִרְדוֹת את כוורתו if a person goes to take the honey out of his bee-hive; מה שכוורתי רוֹדָה כך וכך וכ׳ whatever my bee-hive may yield shall be thine for such and such an amount; a. fr.—2) ר׳ (פת) to detach bread from where it sticks to the oven, to shovel out.

<cite ref="Shabbat 4a:3">Sabb. 4ᵃ</cite> <he>הדביק … התירו לו לִרְדוֹתָהּ וכ׳</he> if a person stuck a loaf to the wall of an oven (on the Sabbath), would you permit him to take it out (before it is baked) &c.? <cite ref="Mishnah Makhshirin 3:3">Makhsh. III, 3</cite>.
<cite ref="Yoma 38a">Yoma 38ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Yoma 2:5">Tosef. ib. II, 5</cite> <he>אינן בקיעין לִרְדוֹתָם</he> they were not skilled in taking them off (without breaking); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 3:3:8">Y. Pes. III, 30ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>יִרְדֶּנָּה</he> let him detach it (the piece dedicated as Ḥallah) from the loaf.

senses.gloss: to be detached, taken out of the oven. Tosef. Yoma l. c. והיה נאפה ונ׳ מבפנים (Var. והיא נִרְדֵּית) it was baked in, and taken out from the interior of the oven; Cant. R. to III, 6 נִרְדִּת.
